title: Two-Day Delivery Promise and the Ostomy Supply Program Expedite Fee
content:
**Delivery service standard - Ostomy Supply Program.** The share of the expedited shipping fee charged on a refill shipped expedited at the customer's request follows Larkfield's two-day promise, measured in calendar days from the refill's ship date to the delivery date on its proof of delivery.

## The rule

Where no proof of delivery is on file the share is nothing; where the delivery came more than 2 days after the ship date, each day beyond the second takes a quarter of the fee off, so the share is the full share less a quarter for every such day, never below nothing; otherwise the share is the full share.

The delivery share multiplies the fee.

| Delivery | Delivery share of the fee |
|---|---|
| No proof of delivery on file | Nothing (0%) |
| 2 days or fewer after the ship date | The full share (100%) |
| 3 days | 75% |
| 4 days | 50% |
| 5 days | 25% |
| 6 days or more | Nothing (never below nothing) |

*Hypothetical illustration:* on a fee of USD 30.00, delivery 4 days after the ship date gives 30.00 multiplied by 50%, that is USD 15.00, before anything else is applied to the charge.
